note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Rust-red plates show speckled high-frequency noise at 1:1 that reads as static, not rust; plate edges slightly soft against the magenta cutouts.
flags.fix: Reduce the high-frequency luminance inject on the red plates and keep the alpha edge sharp; leave the metal top band as is.

flags.problem: 1:1 rock shows dark blotches with pale halo rims that look stamped and painterly rather than individual rock grain; scale is large (141.8 world units per repeat), so the impact is low.
flags.fix: Lower the luminance inject on the blob structure, remove the pale rim halos, and check for repeated stamp patterns across the tile.

flags.problem: 1:1 grass looks mottled and painterly with smeared low-frequency blotches; field boundary edges are soft with slight halos.
flags.fix: Restore fine grass speckle at 1:1 by reducing the low-frequency smoothing; sharpen field edges without adding a dark fringe.

flags.problem: Dark-green field at 1:1 is smeared and close to plastic-smooth; the light field boundary line is blurred into a halo.
flags.fix: Add back the fine mud grain in the dark field areas and sharpen the light boundary line, keeping the luminance inject faint.
